Results of the population structure seminar, and preparing the Chiang Mai–Lampang visit
se: Meeting on Thursday 19 November 2026 at 09.00, Committee Meeting Room CA 330, 3rd floor, Parliament House, according to the meeting notice: the agenda is the results of the seminar “Population Structure and Quality of Life” (12 Nov 2026), the draft schedule of the field visit to Chiang Mai and Lampang, joining the drawing contest in honour of Her Royal Highness Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn, “Our Beloved Princess”, of the subcommittee on older persons, and progress reports from committee members on ad hoc committees. The summary will be added once the Senate publishes it.
